maggie: quick PSA — ran into a weird JSON-mode fncall edge where the SDK helper returns an empty array for an optional union<array,object> schema when the model returns `null` for the array branch. repro in sample-app during onboarding tests.

sam: ugh sorry, can you paste the schema + sample output?

maggie: yeah here’s the schema we use (simplified):
```json
{
  \"type\": \"object\",
  \"properties\": {
    \"result\": {
      \"oneOf\": [
        { \"type\": \"array\", \"items\": {\"type\":\"string\"} },
        { \"type\": \"object\", \"properties\": {\"id\":{\"type\":\"string\"}} }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

maggie: model returned this in JSON-mode fncall: `{\"result\": null}` — SDK helper coerced to `[]` instead of preserving null/trying object branch. causes downstream code expecting object to NPE.

kai: is this the strict json-mode validator or the SDK shim that tries to coerce?

maggie: looks like the helper path that does \"coerce empty -> array\" when it sees oneOf with array branch. stack trace points to `schemaSanitizer.coerceArray()` in ts-sdk.

julio: oh no. Related to retry/auth loop? any extra encoding in logs?

maggie: logging snippet: 
```
[fncall] request id=abc123 payload={...}
[response] raw="{\"result\":null}"
[sdk] coercion: matched branch=array -> returning []
```

sam: could be because `null` is being interpreted as \"missing array\" and defaulting to `[]`. We had a utility that did that for compatibility with old tool outputs.

kai: that utility should only run when schema explicitly has `default: []` or `nullable: false`. Otherwise preserve null.

maggie: agree. quick patch idea: in `coerceArray` short-circuit if value === null and the schema allows `null` (either via `nullable` or a `oneOf`/`anyOf` that includes `null`). Failing that, don't coerce.

julio: can you open a tiny PR? tag me, mark as devex-high. include a unit test using the sample-app runner.

maggie: opening PR now — https://git.redwood/s/sdk/coerce-null-array-fix (WIP). CI shows one flaky test tho, might be unrelated.

devex-bot: CI failed on samplekit/onboard-integration (flake) — build 5291. See logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/5291

sam: for the test, also add a case where schema is union[array,object] with no explicit nullable and model returns null -> expect null (not []). That will catch this.

julio: sounds good. after PR lands, we should cut a patch for the JS SDK and ship a tiny patch release. notify eng-runtime folks in case server-side compatibility bits exist.

maggie: added test + changelog note. will ping once green. thanks y'all :rocket:

sam: nice catch — might save a bunch of onboarding headaches. :thumbsup:

kai: quick follow-up: any connection to the auth/retry double-encode issue we saw last month? this seems purely coercion-level, not transport.

maggie: yeah not related, different stack. but we should add integration test that simulates auth retry + jsonmode to avoid combinatorial regressions.

julio: agreed. i'll file a follow-up ticket after this PR.

maggie: filing: https://tickets.redwood/DEVEX-3427 — "integration tests: auth/retry + json-mode fncall sanity"

sam: perfect. closing the loop once CI passes.

maggie: CI passed, patch released as 0.18.3. rolling notify to sample-app users.

julio: beautiful. :tada:
